reply_text:
I'll start by finding out what "the basic memory system" refers to in the current code and what demos exist, then check whether it runs.Record and interpretation paths check out live; now fixing the brief script's date bug, checking which turns miss their evidence link, and seeing what holds futon1b's read permits.Pulling the futon1b vitality log and the Emacs evidence writer, then I'll write up the findings.㊥ (gist) I followed your own turn just now through every stage of the memory path. Capture, interpretation and pattern retrieval work live. The link from turn records into futon1b is broken, and the cause is futon1b itself: its heap is pinned at the ceiling and it spends most of each second in full garbage collection, so evidence reads time out and writes fall back to the retry queue. One decision for you below. Record: futon3c 9404e08e5, note `holes/labs/M-象-2000/LAB-2026-10-14-live-memory-check.md`.

㊬ ("the basic memory system works") Your message was recorded at 16:12:48Z, read by 象-sonnet 90 s later as `qualify` + `ask-action`, and the prompt header carried three retrieved patterns. The 象 service reports health ok. The frames for this session (54 turns since 10-11) pass five of the six McCarthy checks: ordering, acts named, commits exist, promises accounted, rewind pins. The sixth, "recording is a side effect of acting", fails on 53 of 54 turns, and that failure is the futon1b symptom, not missing replies.

㊩ ("fully integrated") futon1b heap is 4014 of 4096 MB, old generation at 99.5 %, a full GC roughly once a second. Session-scoped evidence queries answer 504 or hang; the health probe is 3 ms, so zone-health says PASS. In your Emacs the last evidence delivery outcome is `retry`, with 452 such retries since it started on 10-08. The outbox is empty, so the rows did land late, but the turn record only learns its evidence id on an immediate ack. Today 16 of 42 operator records have no evidence link, all typed turns since 13:21Z. The text-search sidecar also reports not reconciled since boot. The unit has no memory ceiling set, and the vitality sampler points at a retired unit, so nothing alarmed.

🈸 (one decision) Restart futon1b-zone now? Your 09-08 ruling says futon1b restarts need no quiet time, and the Emacs outbox is the client-side durability that ruling asked for. If the heap pegs again within hours, the working set has outgrown 4 GB and the heap needs raising with a MemoryHigh set under it. I have not touched the JVM.

㊭ (two small fixes, if you want them) Record the deterministic evidence id on a `retry` outcome with a delivery state, so a slow store stops costing the link. Point the vitality sampler at `futon1b-zone.service` so heap over 85 % alarms before an operator turn is the first symptom.

㊢ ("live demos based on my current interactions") All loaded in your running Emacs and checked: `M-x turn-stepper` in this buffer steps SAID / PARSE / PATTERNS / HAPPENED over this session's 54 turns. `M-x xiang-resume-brief` renders the M-象-2000 brief; its `--since` crashed on a bare date and is fixed (6343241a3). `C-c s o` is the session overview. feed.html shows operator turns only. The brief's "awaiting other agents" still lists 59 Zai requisitions that bellbacks closed, the false-open problem on the brief side.
